description: This PHP source file defines an interface 'ReportSearchFilterParams' within the OrangeHRM project, specifying methods to retrieve various filtering parameters related to report search functionality.

classes.name: ReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: An interface that declares methods to access report filtering parameters such as report ID, sort order, sort field, limit, and offset.

methods.name: getReportId
methods.description: Returns the report ID as an integer.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order as a string, possibly e.g., 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

methods.name: getSortField
methods.description: Returns the field name to sort by, or null if not specified.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of results to retrieve.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset from where to start retrieving results.
